notes.title: Diamond Update
notes.notes:
After a lot of feedback now Musasabi has many changes to make the experience more enjoyable and fun, some of the most notable changes are:

Add small diamonds on the path to the final diamond to demarcate the path that must be followed to the final objective and also add an additional objective to the game mechanics.
The speed, quantity, and behavior of the enemies are less aggressive and more predictable so that the experience is not frustrating but fun, the levels have also been modified so that the sections are not so long and tedious.

This is our first major update so we hope that the game has a greater Re-playability value, and hopefully, we can get to please most of our players.
More changes are on their way so we are always attentive to the comments and suggestions of the players so please tell us your ideas so that they are taken into account in the community and in the end they are released in the game.

notes.title: Musasabi will be release soon!
notes.notes:
Musasabi is a platform game where Risu the Musasabi flying squirrel must track and collect the missing gems of the gnomes in order to defeat the evil Akujaku. 

It's a 2D action, retro-style video-game where the hero can move either vertical and horizontally even upside down, is not just a wall jump or gravity inverted but literally walk over the walls and can also glide when is in the air, he can shot acorns as bullets, is a fast-paced game very dynamic.
